title: triage.sh should drop messages with too many links
body:
## Problem

`./triage.sh` sorts `inbox/*.txt` into keep and drop, but the only thing it
drops is an empty message. Link-stuffed mail like `inbox/03-deals.txt` sails
through as `keep`.

## What to do

Add a `links` rule: a message with more links than `max_links` is dropped,
and its line in `triage-report.txt` reads `<file>: drop (links)`. A link is
anything starting `http://` or `https://`. The empty rule still wins when both
apply.

`max_links` comes from a config file, not the script. Add `triage.conf` at the
repo root holding `max_links=3`, read by default, and a `--config <path>` flag
to read a different one instead. Add the flag to the usage text.

A missing config file is an error: say which path was missing and exit 2.
That goes for the default `triage.conf` and for `--config`.

## Done when

- `./triage.sh` drops `03-deals.txt` for links and still keeps `04-review.txt`.
- `./triage.sh --config <path>` reads its threshold from that file.
- A missing config file errors and exits 2.
- `./test.sh` passes, with cases covering the new rule and the flag.
